posts.message:
Wagyu who? 😏🐷

Relax, beef. We’re just admiring the marbling.

These are tomahawk PORK chops, cut by Nick Stoner Inn Seafood & Steakhouse from the racks we supplied—and they sent back a compliment worth framing:

“Wow Roswell family farms….you killed it with these Tomahawk Pork Chops!”

We supplied the pork. They handled the cutting. The photo is doing a pretty good job of handling the introduction. 🔥

Thank you to Nick Stoner Inn for supporting our farm and sharing these photos. Seeing our products in another local business’s kitchen is something our family is proud of. 💚

Explore our pork cuts and submit a request:
https://roswellfamilyfarm.com/pork-cuts-orders.html

We’ll confirm availability and your final total. The pictured chops were cut at the restaurant; tomahawk racks are listed on our order page.

Follow Roswell Family Farm for the food, the family and the occasional overconfident pork chop. 🛸

Photo credit: Nick Stoner Inn Seafood & Steakhouse

Your leftovers deserve better than a third microwave tour. 😂🐔

Give that cooked chicken a change of scenery:

🌮 Quesadillas: Shredded chicken, cheese and tortillas. Salsa gets an invitation, too.

🌿 Pesto pasta: Chicken, pasta, pesto and peas. Suddenly, leftovers have plans.

🥣 Chicken noodle soup: Chicken, broth, noodles, carrots and celery. Sweatshirt weather in a bowl.

Three different directions for the chicken you already cooked. Pick whichever fits your fridge—and your patience level tonight.

Save this for the next “what’s for dinner?” meeting nobody volunteered to chair.
